The mass tolerance between the measured m/z values and the exact mass of each candidate metabolite was set to within 10 mDa. Then, the Mass Fragment application manager was applied to facilitate the analysis of the MS/MS spectra of metabolic ions showing a significant difference using the targeted MS/ MS mode. Lastly, the metabolites were further identified by comparing their mass spectra and retention behavior with the reference MS/MS spectral data in online databases and the litera- ture [30].
